name: Mongoose
solves: Provides elegant MongoDB object modeling for Node.js with schemas, validation, middleware, population, and TypeScript support — the standard ODM for MongoDB in the Node ecosystem.
best_for: Node apps using MongoDB that want schemas, validation, and middleware
Express/NestJS services standardized on Mongoose models
Teams that need population, discriminators, and plugin ecosystems
Rapid API development against document collections
TypeScript projects using Mongoose's type inference helpers
skip_when: Your database is relational (Postgres/MySQL) — use Prisma/Drizzle/Kysely/TypeORM
You want a raw MongoDB driver without ODM overhead
You need SQL migrations and relational joins as first-class features
Edge runtimes cannot embed the Mongoose/driver stack comfortably
You prefer Prisma's MongoDB support for schema-first multi-DB consistency
